mapper.select: SELECT f.id, f.heritage_id, h.name AS heritage_name, h.cover_image, c.name AS category_name, h.level, h.region, f.create_time FROM t_favorite f LEFT JOIN t_heritage h ON f.heritage_id = h.id LEFT JOIN t_heritage_category c ON h.category_id = c.id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND h.deleted_flag = 0 ORDER BY f.create_time DESC
